title: Qualify NFL scoring, active-status and game-completion evidence before fantasy analysis

research_window_utc.note: These examples reflect the bounded public-source research window. This draft does not claim a later news refresh.

purpose: Use public NFL reporting to illustrate what a source establishes and what requires additional evidence.

examples.topic: A scoring play is an outcome, not a complete workload measurement
examples.verified_public_fact: The Jets' official highlight description records a 22-yard go-ahead rushing touchdown in the fourth quarter against Cleveland.

source.title: Jets-Browns Highlight | Braelon Allen Races 22 Yards for a Touchdown
source.material_reviewed: Search-returned official text description. Direct page opening failed; video not watched.

examples.game_status_in_evidence: Fourth-quarter scoring event. This example makes no final-game or complete-box-score assertion.
examples.analytical_lesson: A touchdown does not independently establish increased carry share, routes, snaps, goal-line share or a durable workload change.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: Complete final usage counts, provider definitions and a comparable prior sample.

examples.topic: Multiple active running backs can coexist without an established touch split
examples.verified_public_fact: Seattle's official report confirms Holani active after rib/knee concerns. Wilson and Velus Jones Jr. are also active, while Zach Charbonnet is ruled out.

source.author: John Boyle
source.title: Seahawks vs. 49ers Week 5 Inactives
source.display_timezone: Not stated in the retrieved text.
source.material_reviewed: Search-returned official article text. Direct page opening failed.

examples.game_status_in_evidence: Pregame availability announcement; no final Seattle usage asserted.
examples.analytical_lesson: Active status establishes game-day eligibility. It does not establish an uncontested role, unrestricted health or a particular allocation of touches.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: Subsequent participation and workload evidence, with an observation time distinct from the pregame announcement.

examples.topic: A completed game is not a complete usage dataset
examples.verified_public_fact: The NFL recap confirms that Philadelphia-Jacksonville is complete.

source.title: 2026 NFL season, Week 5: What We Learned from Sunday's games
source.material_reviewed: Search-returned NFL recap text. Direct opening of its AMP copy failed.

examples.analytical_lesson: Final status alone does not supply routes, snaps, target-earning rates or a provider-defined participation denominator. Missing usage must remain unknown rather than be inferred from production.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: A verified final usage source. Preserve raw counts and definitions before calculating rates.

examples.topic: Practice participation, injury designation and official game-day active status are distinct
examples.verified_public_fact: The Ravens' official injury table lists Andrews with a hand injury, full participation Wednesday through Friday, and no game-status designation.
examples.fact_confidence: HIGH for the displayed injury-table contents

sources.title: Ravens Injury Report
sources.material_reviewed: Directly opened official injury-report table showing Baltimore and Atlanta for this matchup.

sources.title: NFL 2026 Baltimore Ravens Schedule
sources.material_reviewed: Search-returned official schedule text; October 11 kickoff listed at 8:20 PM Eastern.

examples.verification_limit: No official game-day inactive list confirming Andrews active was obtained in this bounded scan. This does not mean he is inactive.
examples.analytical_lesson: No injury designation supports a different claim from confirmed game-day active status. A later active confirmation should retain its own source and observation time.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: The official game-day inactive list or another explicit official confirmation.

methodological_limits: Some search extracts and public pages had different crawl freshness. A scheduled ending time is not proof that a game is final.
Search-returned text is distinguished from a directly opened page and from video viewing.
Corroboration of an existing fact does not create a second independent underlying event.
These examples support source qualification only. They establish no calibrated player forecast, current fantasy move, betting recommendation, decision grade or adopted signal weight.
forecast_handling: No forecast is created here. Preserve any original contemporaneous forecast and add later outcomes with their own timestamps; never reconstruct a pregame claim from a known result.
future_corrections: Add a later dated clarification if new evidence changes an interpretation; preserve this time-bounded record.
